jyutping: m4 gei3 dak1 baai2 zo2 hai2 bin1

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose way to say that you put an item somewhere and no longer remember where.

examples.english: I often misplace my keys and end up searching everywhere.
examples.traditional: 我成日唔記得擺咗把鎖匙喺邊，搞到周圍搵。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 m4 gei3 dak1 baai2 zo2 baa2 so2 si4 hai2 bin1 gaau2 dou3 zau1 wai4 wan2
